name: Premier Tank Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Premier Tank Corporation Public Company Limited is involved in the storage and logistical distribution of fuel across Thailand. The company primarily offers comprehensive fuel depot services, with a strong focus on the Northeastern region of the country. Its key facilities include the Khon Kaen oil depot, which processes an impressive 4.2 million liters of fuel output daily, and the Sisaket oil terminal, capable of distributing 2.6 million liters of oil each day. Originally established in 2013 as Premier Tank Corporation Company Limited, the firm now operates under its current name and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
